summary: Embraer S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing that the Hellenic Ministry of National Defense signed a contract for three KC-390 Millennium aircraft, with options for three more, via a government-to-government agreement between Greece and Portugal. First delivery is slated for 2027. No price, share count, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; the item is an ordinary defense sales order, not a corporate special situation, and carries no structural or regulatory-clock implications. What to watch: order backlog conversion and any exercise of the three options.
